title: CS Growth 1:1 runbook — quick notes
content:
Quick context / purpose:
- 30m sync with Samir (AE) + Tara (SE) — focus: two mid-market upsell opportunities, blockers for Q2 expansion, and alignment on next customer touchpoints.
- Keep it tactical: owners + clear due dates. Prep + lightweight playbook to reuse for similar accounts.

Agenda (30m)
- 0-5m: quick wins + health snapshot (Maya)
- 5-15m: Account deep-dive A: NovaPay (Samir lead) — success metrics needed to propose expansion
- 15-25m: Account deep-dive B: HealthGrid (Tara lead) — SE technical blockers + timeline
- 25-30m: actions, follow-ups, and who emails whom

Pre-read (1 pager to drop into thread before meeting):
- NovaPay: usage trend last 30d: +18% token volume, top route = chat, cost/unit trending up 7% -> why?
- HealthGrid: PoC cluster is patched but failing KV cache warm on warm-start -> reported to infra (CS-1245).

NovaPay (upsell target) notes:
- Current package: Dedicated-2 (monthly commit), approaching burst cap on weekdays.
- Signals: rising usage, request for lower-latency (<120ms p95), asked about multi-region.
- Value props to push: Dedicated-4 upgrade (predictable throughput), autoscaling buffer, and routing policy tie-in to reduce cross-region egress.
- Risks: procurement timeline (legal asks 6–8 weeks), procurement flagged COST by finance team.
- Quant ask / prep: need accurate predicted token delta if we add 2x concurrency. Ask infra for cost estimate by Tue 3/16.
- Questions for Samir to surface to buyer:
  * Which app path is highest priority for latency (checkout? fraud check?)
  * Who owns the procurement timeline & budget sign-off?
  * Any compliance docs needed for Dedicated+Private?

HealthGrid (technical blocker) notes:
- PoC cluster: intermittent 503s during peak prefix caching. Logged as CS-1245 assigned to infra.
- SE tasks for Tara: reproduce with load script (script exists in GH PR #342), test with quantized model variant, try prefix caching off as temporary workaround.
- Customer asks for a deterministic failover plan: recommend canary fallback to smaller model for degraded SLOs.
- Proposed ETA: repro + fix candidate by 3/19, customer update 3/20. Flag if delayed.

Metrics snapshot (ready to state quickly):
- Net usage growth (top accounts): NovaPay +18% M/M, HealthGrid +12% M/M.
- Latency p95 baseline: hosted api 95ms, Dedicated-2 current p95 140ms for priority routes.
- Renewal health score: NovaPay 7/10 (usage good, procurement risk), HealthGrid 6/10 (tech risk).

Playbook snippets to reuse (one-liners):
- If usage >15% M/M -> trigger capacity review + cost-estimate (owner: Maya)
- If p95 dedicated >120ms -> SE triage + kernel/runtime snapshot (owner: Tara)
- If procurement >4 weeks -> propose interim dedicated burst + credit for migration (owner: Samir)

Meeting prompts (shorthand for Samir/Tara to answer quickly):
- Samir: who is economic buyer? what exact KPIs they show to execs? expected sign date range?
- Tara: can you run the repro script locally and paste logs in thread? is quantized model an acceptable interim?

Action items (make sure to capture owner + due date)
- [ ] Ask infra for 2x concurrency cost estimate for NovaPay (owner: Maya) — due 2026-03-16
- [ ] Samir to confirm buyer & procurement ETA for NovaPay; add to renewal doc (owner: Samir Rao) — due 2026-03-14
- [ ] Tara to run GH PR#342 script, attach logs + initial mitigation (owner: Tara Lin) — due 2026-03-15
- [ ] Draft upsell one-pager for NovaPay (propose Dedicated-4 + autoscale) (owner: Maya) — due 2026-03-18
- [ ] Update HealthGrid status note and propose fallback model plan (owner: Maya/Tara) — due 2026-03-20
- [ ] Quick customer email draft (Samir to send) summarizing next steps and ETA (owner: Samir Rao) — due 2026-03-16

Draft follow-up email snippet (one paragraph — send after meeting):
Hi <CustomerName>, thanks again for the time today. Quick update: we've opened a targeted engineering investigation into the cache warm failures (ticket CS-1245), Tara will run a repro and propose a fallback by 3/19. On the capacity side, we're modeling two upgrade scenarios and will share a concise cost + performance comparison by 3/16. I'll follow up with next steps and proposed dates for a technical review and procurement conversation.

Notes-to-self / friction points to watch (scratchpad):
- Keep messaging simple around cost: show delta per-100k tokens and latency delta.
- Avoid talking about model internals in exec calls; focus on outcome (p95/throughput/cost).
- Legal procurement often asks for SOC2 + data flow diagram — confirm with legal if recent package changed.

Open questions (for post-meeting research):
- Has finance at NovaPay seen the last month’s cost forecast? (Who from AE can introduce?)
- Is HealthGrid willing to accept minor accuracy delta for fallback model? (we need explicit sign-off)

Next 2 steps (immediate):
1) Send pre-read + agenda to Samir/Tara now (Maya)
2) Quick sync in 30m to confirm final talking points (15m) before customer touch

End of runbook — keep this one as template for similar AE/SE/CS 1:1s.

-- Maya
